import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static final long MODFINAL = 1000000007L;
    static long[] pw10 = new long[17];

    static long countWithPrefix(String s, long n, String nStr) {
        long ans = 0;
        long sVal = 0;
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray())
            sVal = 10 * sVal + (ch - '0');
        for (int len = s.length(); len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            if (len < nStr.length()) {
                ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
            } else {
                int cmp = s.compareTo(nStr.substring(0, s.length()));
                if (cmp < 0) {
                    ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
                } else if (cmp == 0) {
                    ans += (n + 1) - sVal * pw10[nStr.length() - s.length()];
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void solve(ArrayList<Integer> variables, int base, BigInteger[] ans) {
        int n = variables.size();
        int half = n / 2;
        ArrayList<Integer> rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer> rem2 = new ArrayList<>();

        int total1 = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; ++i) total1 *= 10;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < total1; ++mask) {
            int cur = base;
            int m = mask;
            for (int i = 0; i < half; ++i) {
                int digit = m % 10;
                m /= 10;
                cur = (cur + digit * variables.get(i)) % MOD;
            }
            rem1.add(cur);
        }

        int total2 = 1;
        for (int i = half; i < n; ++i) total2 *= 10;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < total2; ++mask) {
            int cur = 0;
            int m = mask;
            for (int i = half; i < n; ++i) {
                int digit = m % 10;
                m /= 10;
                cur = (cur + digit * variables.get(i)) % MOD;
            }
            rem2.add(cur);
        }

        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);

        long totalRSum = 0;
        for (int b : rem2)
            totalRSum += b;

        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && a + rem2.get(j) >= MOD)
                --j;
            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(a * (long) rem2.size() + totalRSum - (rem2.size() - 1 - j) * (long) MOD));
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        scanner.close();

        String nStr = "";
        long t = n;
        while (t > 0) {
            nStr = (char)('0' + t % 10) + nStr;
            t /= 10;
        }
        if (nStr.isEmpty()) nStr = "0";

        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i)
            pw10[i] = 10 * pw10[i - 1];

        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.ZERO;

        for (int len = 1; len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            long cur = 0;
            StringBuilder curSt = new StringBuilder();

            for (int firstDiff = 0; firstDiff < nStr.length() && firstDiff < len; ++firstDiff) {
                if (firstDiff > 0) {
                    cur = 10 * cur + (nStr.charAt(firstDiff - 1) - '0');
                    curSt.append(nStr.charAt(firstDiff - 1));
                }

                for (int lastDig = 0; lastDig <= 9; ++lastDig) {
                    if (firstDiff == 0 && lastDig == 0)
                        continue;
                    if (lastDig == nStr.charAt(firstDiff) - '0')
                        continue;
                    if (len == nStr.length() && lastDig > nStr.charAt(firstDiff) - '0')
                        continue;

                    long curP = 10 * cur + lastDig;
                    String curStP = curSt.toString() + (char)('0' + lastDig);

                    long base = 0;
                    StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curStP.length(); ++pos) {
                        char start = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0');
                        for (char dig = start; dig < curStP.charAt(pos); ++dig)
                            base += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                        tmp.append(curStP.charAt(pos));
                    }
                    base += len - 1;

                    ArrayList<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int pos = curStP.length(); pos < len; ++pos) {
                        variables.add((int)(countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + '0', n, nStr) % MOD));
                        tmp.append('0');
                    }

                    base += 1;
                    base -= curP * pw10[len - curStP.length()];
                    for (int tIdx = 0; tIdx < variables.size(); ++tIdx)
                        variables.set(variables.size() - 1 - tIdx, (int)((variables.get(variables.size() - 1 - tIdx) - pw10[tIdx]) % MOD));

                    base %= MOD;
                    if (base < 0)
                        base += MOD;

                    for (int idx = 0; idx < variables.size(); ++idx) {
                        int val = variables.get(idx) % MOD;
                        if (val < 0)
                            val += MOD;
                        variables.set(idx, val);
                    }

                    BigInteger[] ansRef = new BigInteger[]{ans};
                    solve(variables, (int)base, ansRef);
                    ans = ansRef[0];
                }
            }
        }

        long cur = 0;
        StringBuilder curSt = new StringBuilder();

        for (int len = 1; len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            curSt.append(nStr.charAt(len - 1));
            cur = 10 * cur + (nStr.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1;
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curSt.length(); ++pos) {
                char start = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0');
                for (char dig = start; dig < curSt.charAt(pos); ++dig)
                    val += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                tmp.append(curSt.charAt(pos));
            }
            val += len - 1;
            val -= cur;
            val %= MOD;
            if (val < 0)
                val += MOD;

            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(val));
        }

        ans = ans.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(MODFINAL));
        System.out.println(ans.toString());
    }
}
